suite_overlap: The 44 C6+C5+C4 cases are a subset of the 96-case suite, rerun with python -S. Do not add them as unique tests. The 21 skipped cases require the unavailable optional tokenizer dependency; remaining no-site cases execute. The archived 94/42 and earlier 93/41 results do not describe this corrected source.
log_capture: Each listed v2 log contains the actual child process stdout plus stderr captured by subprocess.run(stdout=PIPE, stderr=STDOUT) and written directly as bytes. No independent stdout/stderr streams are claimed. Both suites were correctness executions, not latency measurements.

superseded_before_performance.reason: Independent review found cross-span and repeated-page sharing of mutable nested source-reference JSON containers. The fixed fast path is single-span and consumes each captured graph only once.

coverage: Multi-session batching returns the same exact requested source-turn mapping, including missing turns. EXPLAIN confirms the existing composite session/ordinal index lookup.

A single-span fixture observes one batch instead of multiple per-session queries and removal of a duplicate final source_refs parse. Multiple spans and repeated pages intentionally retain original independent JSON parses.

Single/empty sessions, non-native types, mixed/overflow ordinals, 400-pair boundary, 401 pairs, absent getlimit, custom connection/row/text factories, and restrictive variable/SQL length/column/expression/compound/VM limits use the original path.
Full payloads and exact counts match the original source work path for both encoders, zero/tiny/large token caps, character caps, project scope and single-session scope.
Original source-map and projected-unit errors survive changed source text, invalid JSON, missing/overflow/mixed source ordinals.
Custom prepare mutation, custom reference projection and JSON loaders retain their original calls; a JSON wrapper installed before store import is not certified.

Late custom breadcrumbs replacing raw references, replacing id with a nonhashable list, replacing _refs/json.loads or deleting raw references preserve original outputs/errors; empty spans do not parse/access missing raw references.

No private keys are added to selected rows or assembly/breadcrumb inputs. Source-reference reuse is restricted to one ordinary span and consumes each captured page graph once; multi-span and repeated-page outputs preserve independent message_indices lists and unknown nested JSON objects, verified by identity and mutation tests.
Existing C5 memo, C4 scope/ranking, token assembly, prefix/sealed counting, real SDK token payloads and persistent MCP lifecycle tests pass.
